description_expanded:
This brand new condominium at Alys Beach is located in the recently-completed Della building. This second floor home features a large balcony overlooking Town Center and the Amphitheatre with a partial Gulf view in the distance. This vacation rental also offers a spacious family room, dining area and kitchen with a large center island. Both the primary bedroom and the second bedroom feature one king-sized bed and ensuite baths. A powder room is also located off of the family room. The bunk area sleeps four with two upper and two lower single bunks. Finally, both bedrooms and the bunk area offer access to another private balcony overlooking the rear of the building. Parking for Della 205 is located in a parking court behind the building with one reserved space. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding Della 205. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
